events.title: Splash Screen Patch
events.summary: PATCH NOTICEEmployee feedback has been reviewed. Several employees described onboarding as "a lot." Management disagrees, but has made the following adjustments. Splash screens can now be skipped. Press any key. The demo welcome screen has been rewritten. It is shorter and now mentions the Hunters. Thank you for your service, and thank you for the feedback. If something in the demo felt confusing or unfair, tell us in the discussions or on Discord. A solo developer reads all of it.

events.summary: NEURAL REPAIR — DEMO UPDATENewHunters. From level 5, a corrupted program stalks the grid. It starts slow and lazy, then hops faster and tracks you more closely as you go deeper. A red reticle warns you before every hop. If it lands on you, or you walk into it, you lose stability. Later levels bring a second Hunter. events.title: Neural Repair Demo Release!
events.summary: The Demo will be dropping on September 18th! Keep in mind this is just the base game loop and there is so much more work to do on the game. It's really fun, especially once you start figuring it out! The demo is capped at 20 levels but because of the procedural generation, even on the demo version, each run will be different.
